_note: Run premise. Every run: you carry a P.A.U.S.E. unit, the Sentinels hunt you, get it home. Home + backstory depend on the start faction (more factions / start ships later).

company.name: PROMETHEUS ATOMIC
company.about: Pre-war company that built every atomic reactor in America (homes, cars, airships). Also built P.A.U.S.E.

pause.about: Stops time in one fight (like V.A.T.S.). Very rare, cannot be rebuilt – the knowledge is lost. Others may own one too.

ironmall.title: IRON MALL // EMERGENCY LOG
lines: The Sentinels hit us on the way home. We got out – barely.
Three of us left. The rest of the crew are scattered across the wasteland.
But the crate is still in the hold: a Prometheus Atomic P.A.U.S.E. unit, pulled from the old military ruin.
The Sentinels know we have it. The Iron Mall is far – we won't make it in one go.
Get it home. If they catch up – use it.
